items.followUp: Define community level of biological organization.

rubric.why: The control group provides a comparison without the treatment being tested.
rubric.description: States that the control group does not receive the treatment being tested.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying that the control group receives no treatment.

rubric.why: The experimental group is exposed to the factor being investigated.
rubric.description: States that the experimental group receives the treatment or tested factor.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying what the experimental group receives.

modelAnswer: The control group receives no treatment and is kept under normal conditions.
The experimental group receives the treatment or factor being tested.

items.followUp: State one similarity and one difference between the cell wall and the plasma membrane.

rubric.why: Cell membrane and plasma membrane are names for the same cell boundary.
rubric.description: Identifies the terms as referring to the same structure, not two different membranes.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the terms are equivalent.

rubric.why: Selective permeability and regulation of movement are key features of this membrane.
rubric.description: States that the membrane is selectively permeable or controls movement of substances.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for giving a correct property or function.

modelAnswer: Cell membrane and plasma membrane are two names for the same structure, not two different membranes.
This membrane is selectively permeable and controls the movement of substances into and out of the cell.
